raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### Summary

GLM-5.3-Flash (`glm5_next`) fails to start with any EAGLE-family drafter whose layers are plain sliding-window attention (e.g. the block-diffusion DFlash2 drafter, 5 GQA `SlidingWindowSpec` layers). `_get_kv_cache_groups_glm5_next` only accepts exact `MLAAttentionSpec` in the attention group, so it declines; the generic page-size unification then cannot pad the DSA indexer (MLA family) and startup dies:

```
NotImplementedError: indexer.k_cache: page size is not divisible by the maximum
page size and cannot be padded. Padding is only supported for non-MLA attention layers
```

This is the same direction as the draft-group work in #58638 (KV cache grouping for hybrid models with speculative drafters), applied to the GLM-5.3 builder, which was not covered there.

### Root cause

`_get_kv_cache_groups_glm5_next` builds one packed group for `MLAAttentionSpec` + indexer (MLA with `tokens_per_state > 1`) layers and aliases the kpool tails onto the indexer tensors. Its gate requires every non-Mamba / non-`KpoolTailSpec` spec to be exactly `MLAAttentionSpec`. A drafter contributes uniform `SlidingWindowSpec` layers with the draft worker's own (small) block size, so the gate returns `None`. The generic `unify_kv_cache_spec_page_size` then tries to pad every page up to the max (MLA) page; the indexer page is MLA-family and explicitly refuses padding, so `get_kv_cache_groups` raises.

### Changes

One file, `vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_utils.py`:

- `_get_kv_cache_groups_glm5_next` splits `HiddenStateCacheSpec` (aux-eagle) and uniform drafter `SlidingWindowSpec` layers (excluding `KpoolTailSpec` / sliding-window MLA) out of `attn_specs`; the strict all-MLA gate now only applies to the target's attention layers. Absorbing the extras requires `speculative_config.use_eagle()`.
- Draft layers get their own `KVCacheGroupSpec`, re-aligned to the target block size (the packed GLM layout needs a single LCM / scheduler block), with `is_eagle_group=use_eagle_block_drop()` and `enable_kv_transfer=False`; hidden-state layers get one group each.
- `_glm5_next_tensor_layout` accepts such extra groups only when they are sliding-window / hidden-state and share the attention block size; anything else still declines the grouping.
- The extra regions are appended after the packed MLA+indexer regions of the GLM block (per-layer tensors, offset = `extra_base + region_bytes * num_blocks`), and `_get_kv_cache_bytes_per_block`, `get_kv_cache_config_from_groups` and `_max_memory_usage_bytes_from_groups` charge the extra groups at the packed stride.

No behavior change for models without a drafter (all existing glm5 tests pass unchanged), and no change for non-GLM spec-decode groupings.

### Reproduction (CPU-only, no weights)

```python
import torch
from types import SimpleNamespace
from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_utils import _get_kv_cache_groups_glm5_next
from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import (
    MLAAttentionSpec, SlidingWindowSpec, MambaSpec, KpoolTailSpec)

BS, BF16 = 1280, torch.bfloat16   # unified block after mamba alignment
specs = {}
for i in range(11):  # 11 dense MLA + indexer + kpool tail layers
    specs[f"layers.{4*i+3}.attn"] = MLAAttentionSpec(
        block_size=BS, num_kv_heads=1, head_size=576, head_size_v=0,
        dtype=BF16, cache_dtype_str=None)
    specs[f"layers.{4*i+3}.indexer"] = MLAAttentionSpec(
        block_size=BS, num_kv_heads=1, head_size=128, head_size_v=0,
        dtype=torch.uint8, cache_dtype_str=None, tokens_per_state=8)
    specs[f"layers.{4*i+3}.tail"] = KpoolTailSpec(
        block_size=BS, num_kv_heads=1, head_size=128, head_size_v=0,
        dtype=torch.uint8, sliding_window=32, tokens_per_state=8)
for i in range(34):  # 34 KDA/mamba layers
    specs[f"layers.{i}.kda"] = MambaSpec(
        block_size=BS, shapes=((8, 128, 128), (8, 128, 256)),
        dtypes=(BF16, BF16))
for i in range(5):   # drafter: 5 GQA sliding-window layers @ draft block size
    specs[f"draft.layers.{i}.self_attn.attn"] = SlidingWindowSpec(
        block_size=16, num_kv_heads=2, head_size=128, head_size_v=128,
        dtype=BF16, sliding_window=2048)

spec_cfg = SimpleNamespace(
    method="dflash", use_eagle=lambda: True, use_eagle_block_drop=lambda: True,
    num_speculative_tokens=8, use_multi_module_mtp=lambda: False)
cfg = SimpleNamespace(
    cache_config=SimpleNamespace(num_gpu_blocks_override=None, mamba_cache_mode="align",
                                 prefix_match_unit=16, prefix_cache_retention_interval=1280,
                                 block_size=BS),
    parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(pipeline_parallel_size=1, decode_context_parallel_size=1,
                                    enable_expert_parallel=True, tensor_parallel_size=4),
    speculative_config=spec_cfg,
    model_config=SimpleNamespace(max_model_len=262144),
    max_in_flight_tokens=64,
    scheduler_config=SimpleNamespace(max_num_seqs=4))

print(_get_kv_cache_groups_glm5_next(cfg, dict(specs)))  # None on main
```

On unpatched main the builder returns `None`; running the same spec map through `get_kv_cache_groups` ends with the `NotImplementedError` above (the indexer page cannot be padded to the MLA page).

### Tests

- New unit tests in `tests/v1/core/test_kv_cache_utils.py`:
  `test_glm5_next_drafter_gets_its_own_eagle_group` (builder produces the drafter group with `is_eagle_group`, target block size, draft regions appended after the packed regions with no overlap with any other tensor, correct bytes-per-block and max-memory accounting) and `test_glm5_next_drafter_gate_requires_eagle_family` (builder declines without an EAGLE-family spec config). Both fail on main (RED: no draft group) and pass with the fix.
- `tests/v1/core/test_kv_cache_utils.py`: 158 passed; the 3 pre-existing `estimate_max_model_len` / `get_max_concurrency` cases are unchanged env/network cases.

### Verified

End-to-end on 4×A100 (TP4+EP4, AWQ W4A16, ctx 262144, block 1280) with the `GLM-5.3-Flash-DFlash2` drafter: server starts, prefix caching / reasoning & tool parsers work, speculative acceptance metrics normal; stable for hours under agent traffic.

### Note for reviewers

The one visible side effect: the GLM block is mamba-aligned (1280 tokens at TP4 in our setup), so `prefix_cache_retention_interval` must stay a multiple of the unified block — the builder already requires the extra groups to share the attention block size, which is what makes the layout valid.

Related: #58638 (RFC: KV cache grouping for hybrid models with speculative drafters)

Rebased-check done today against current `main` (`b9b401b2`): this PR is superseded and I'm closing it.

Two upstream changes landed while this PR was open and removed the ground it stood on:

- #57169 deleted `_get_kv_cache_groups_glm5_next` / `_glm5_next_tensor_layout` entirely in favor of the generic packed KV layout (+ `CircularBufferSpec` for the kpool tail), and
- #61183 moved all grouping/sizing logic to `vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_planning.py`.

I re-ran the exact repro from the PR description (GLM-5.3-Flash shape @ TP4: 11 `MLAAttentionSpec` bs=1280 + 11 indexer MLA `tokens_per_state=8` + 11 `CircularBufferSpec` tail ring=16 + 34 KDA `MambaSpec` + 5 DFlash2 `SlidingWindowSpec` bs=16, plus the aux-eagle `HiddenStateCacheSpec`) through `get_kv_cache_groups` + `get_kv_cache_config_from_groups` on current main, CPU-only, both layouts and with/without the drafter and hidden-state layer — 8/8 combinations now succeed, and the old `NotImplementedError: indexer.k_cache: page size is not divisible by the maximum page size` no longer reproduces:

- on `LBHNC`, for this shape @ TP4 the indexer page (20,480 B) and the draft page (16,384 B) both divide the target MLA page (1,474,560 B) exactly, so `unify_kv_cache_spec_page_size` rescales their block sizes (indexer 1280→92,160; draft 16→1,440) instead of trying to pad the MLA-family page — the draft keeps real sliding-window semantics in its own uniform group. Where pages cannot be unified, the new promote-SWA-to-full-allocation fallback applies (upstream covers that scenario with `test_mla_with_incompatible_swa_uses_one_full_allocation_group`);
- on `BLHNC`, `_get_packed_kv_cache_groups` gives the draft its own small group without touching the indexer at all.

So the crash this PR fixed is genuinely gone via the generic mechanism — no value in reviving the GLM-specific builder.

One residual I did hit while re-testing, filed separately as #61443 — it's a different (much smaller) issue than this PR: with this spec set + `method=dflash`, main logs `Speculative decoding (method=dflash) is enabled but no KV cache group could be identified as the draft model's` — the draft group is never annotated `is_eagle_group` (details in the follow-up issue opened as #61443, cross-linked from #60560).

Thanks to the KV-cache folks for landing the generic version while this was open — much better than my builder would have been.

     )
 
 
+def _glm5_kv_cache_spec_with_drafter() -> dict[str, KVCacheSpec]:
+    """GLM-5.3-Flash shape plus a block-diffusion drafter's 5 sliding-window
+    layers, which run with the draft worker's small block size."""
+    kv_cache_spec = _glm5_like_kv_cache_spec_with_tail()
+    for i in range(5):
+        kv_cache_spec[f"draft.layers.{i}.self_attn.attn"] = SlidingWindowSpec(
+            block_size=16,
+            num_kv_heads=2,
+            head_size=128,
+            head_size_v=128,
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            sliding_window=2048,
+        )
+    return kv_cache_spec
+
+
+def _glm5_drafter_grouping_config() -> SimpleNamespace:
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        scheduler_config=SimpleNamespace(disable_hybrid_kv_cache_manager=False),
+        attention_config=SimpleNamespace(hisparse_config=None),
+        cache_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            num_gpu_blocks_override=None,
+            prefix_cache_retention_interval=0,
+            mamba_cache_mode="none",
+            get_resolved_kv_cache_layout=lambda: SimpleNamespace(
+                is_block_outermost=True
+            ),
+        ),

+            pipeline_parallel_size=1, decode_context_parallel_size=1
+        ),
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(max_model_len=8192),
+        max_in_flight_tokens=64,
+        speculative_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            method="dflash",
+            use_eagle=lambda: True,
+            use_eagle_block_drop=lambda: True,
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def _glm5_kv_cache_spec_with_drafter() -> dict[str, KVCacheSpec]:
+    """GLM-5.3-Flash shape plus a block-diffusion drafter's 5 sliding-window
+    layers, which run with the draft worker's small block size."""
+    kv_cache_spec = _glm5_like_kv_cache_spec_with_tail()
+    for i in range(5):
+        kv_cache_spec[f"draft.layers.{i}.self_attn.attn"] = SlidingWindowSpec(
+            block_size=16,
+            num_kv_heads=2,
+            head_size=128,
+            head_size_v=128,
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            sliding_window=2048,
+        )
+    return kv_cache_spec
+
+
+def _glm5_drafter_grouping_config() -> SimpleNamespace:
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        scheduler_config=SimpleNamespace(disable_hybrid_kv_cache_manager=False),
+        attention_config=SimpleNamespace(hisparse_config=None),
+        cache_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            num_gpu_blocks_override=None,
+            prefix_cache_retention_interval=0,
+            mamba_cache_mode="none",
+            get_resolved_kv_cache_layout=lambda: SimpleNamespace(
+                is_block_outermost=True
+            ),
+        ),
+        parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            pipeline_parallel_size=1, decode_context_parallel_size=1
+        ),
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            max_model_len=8192,
+            hf_config=SimpleNamespace(model_type="glm5_next"),
+        ),
+        max_in_flight_tokens=64,
+        speculative_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            method="dflash",
+            use_eagle=lambda: True,
+            use_eagle_block_drop=lambda: True,
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def test_glm5_next_drafter_gets_its_own_eagle_group():
+    """A drafter's uniform sliding-window layers must not drag the GLM-5.3
+    hybrid off its packed MLA/indexer layout: the builder declines only for
+    non-EAGLE spec configs; with a drafter enabled they get their own group
+    at the target block size, flagged as the draft group, and their regions
+    are appended after the packed MLA+indexer regions instead of going
+    through page unification (which cannot pad the MLA indexer)."""
+    vllm_config = _glm5_drafter_grouping_config()
+    kv_cache_spec = _glm5_kv_cache_spec_with_drafter()
+    mla_page = kv_cache_spec["layers.3.attn"].page_size_bytes
+    idx_page = kv_cache_spec["layers.3.indexer"].page_size_bytes
+
+    groups = kv_cache_utils.get_kv_cache_groups(vllm_config, kv_cache_spec)
+
+    draft_groups = [group for group in groups if group.is_eagle_group]
+    assert len(draft_groups) == 1
+    draft_group = draft_groups[0]
+    draft_names = sorted(n for n in kv_cache_spec if n.startswith("draft."))
+    assert sorted(draft_group.layer_names) == draft_names
+    assert not draft_group.enable_kv_transfer
+    # Draft pages are re-aligned to the target block size (single LCM block).
+    target_block_size = kv_cache_spec["layers.3.attn"].block_size
+    assert draft_group.kv_cache_spec.block_size == target_block_size
+    draft_page = draft_group.kv_cache_spec.page_size_bytes
+    assert draft_page == len(draft_names) * target_block_size * 2 * 256 * 2
+
+    assert kv_cache_utils._glm5_next_tensor_layout(groups) is not None
+    bytes_per_block = kv_cache_utils._pool_bytes_per_block(groups)
+    assert bytes_per_block == 11 * mla_page + 11 * idx_page + draft_page
+
+    kv_cache_config = kv_cache_utils.get_kv_cache_config_from_groups(
+        vllm_config, groups, bytes_per_block * 100 + 1
+    )
+    assert kv_cache_config.num_blocks == 100
+    tensors = _tensor_by_layer(kv_cache_config)
+    assert {t.size for t in kv_cache_config.kv_cache_tensors} == {bytes_per_block * 100}
+
+    # Draft regions live after the packed MLA+indexer regions and alias
+    # nothing (the mamba views all ride the MLA offsets).
+    packed_end = (11 * mla_page + 11 * idx_page) * kv_cache_config.num_blocks
+    draft_regions = []
+    for name in draft_names:
+        tensor = tensors[name]
+        lo = tensor.offset
+        hi = tensor.offset + tensor.block_stride * kv_cache_config.num_blocks
+        assert lo >= packed_end
+        assert hi <= tensor.size
+        draft_regions.append((name, lo, hi))
+    for name_a, lo_a, hi_a in draft_regions:
+        for tensor in kv_cache_config.kv_cache_tensors:
+            if tensor.layers[0] in draft_names:
+                continue
+            olo = tensor.offset
+            ohi = tensor.offset + tensor.block_stride * kv_cache_config.num_blocks
+            assert hi_a <= olo or ohi <= lo_a, f"overlap {name_a} vs {tensor.layers}"
+    for i, (na, lo_a, hi_a) in enumerate(draft_regions):
+        for nb, lo_b, hi_b in draft_regions[i + 1 :]:
+            assert hi_a <= lo_b or hi_b <= lo_a, f"overlap {na} vs {nb}"
+
+    # Accounting charges the draft group its own blocks at the packed stride.
+    attn_group = next(
+        group
+        for group in groups
+        if isinstance(group.kv_cache_spec, UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs)
+        and not group.is_eagle_group
+    )
+    attn_blocks = attn_group.kv_cache_spec.max_memory_usage_pages(vllm_config)
+    mamba_blocks_per_group = 1 + new_mamba_spec().num_speculative_blocks
+    draft_blocks = (
+        draft_group.kv_cache_spec.max_memory_usage_bytes(vllm_config) // draft_page
+    )
+    blocks_per_request = attn_blocks + 4 * mamba_blocks_per_group + 1 + draft_blocks

Rebased-check done today against current `main` (`b9b401b2`): this PR is superseded and I'm closing it.

Two upstream changes landed while this PR was open and removed the ground it stood on:

- #57169 deleted `_get_kv_cache_groups_glm5_next` / `_glm5_next_tensor_layout` entirely in favor of the generic packed KV layout (+ `CircularBufferSpec` for the kpool tail), and
- #61183 moved all grouping/sizing logic to `vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_planning.py`.

I re-ran the exact repro from the PR description (GLM-5.3-Flash shape @ TP4: 11 `MLAAttentionSpec` bs=1280 + 11 indexer MLA `tokens_per_state=8` + 11 `CircularBufferSpec` tail ring=16 + 34 KDA `MambaSpec` + 5 DFlash2 `SlidingWindowSpec` bs=16, plus the aux-eagle `HiddenStateCacheSpec`) through `get_kv_cache_groups` + `get_kv_cache_config_from_groups` on current main, CPU-only, both layouts and with/without the drafter and hidden-state layer — 8/8 combinations now succeed, and the old `NotImplementedError: indexer.k_cache: page size is not divisible by the maximum page size` no longer reproduces:

- on `LBHNC`, for this shape @ TP4 the indexer page (20,480 B) and the draft page (16,384 B) both divide the target MLA page (1,474,560 B) exactly, so `unify_kv_cache_spec_page_size` rescales their block sizes (indexer 1280→92,160; draft 16→1,440) instead of trying to pad the MLA-family page — the draft keeps real sliding-window semantics in its own uniform group. Where pages cannot be unified, the new promote-SWA-to-full-allocation fallback applies (upstream covers that scenario with `test_mla_with_incompatible_swa_uses_one_full_allocation_group`);
- on `BLHNC`, `_get_packed_kv_cache_groups` gives the draft its own small group without touching the indexer at all.

So the crash this PR fixed is genuinely gone via the generic mechanism — no value in reviving the GLM-specific builder.

One residual I did hit while re-testing, filed separately as #61443 — it's a different (much smaller) issue than this PR: with this spec set + `method=dflash`, main logs `Speculative decoding (method=dflash) is enabled but no KV cache group could be identified as the draft model's` — the draft group is never annotated `is_eagle_group` (details in the follow-up issue opened as #61443, cross-linked from #60560).

Thanks to the KV-cache folks for landing the generic version while this was open — much better than my builder would have been.
